newsitem.title: INDONESIA: ASTRA REVISES UP 1997 NET FORECAST TO 721 BLN RPH.
newsitem.headline: ASTRA REVISES UP 1997 NET FORECAST TO 721 BLN RPH.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automobile manufacturer PT Astra International said on Thursday that it exppected to post net profit of 721 billion rupiah in 1997, up from a previous forecast of 627 billion rupiah.
"We are expecting better margins," Astra Finance Director Rini Soewandi said at a company briefing.
She added that revenues in the year were likely to reach 16.3 trillion rupiah, against a previous forecast 15.4 trillion rupiah.
Astra announced earlier that it had posted net profit of 349.20 billion rupiah in the first six months of 1997 against 182.83 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
The company posted net profit of 470 billion rupiah in the full 1996 year.
Soewandi however said the company would be hit by the weakness in the rupiah, adding that it had a total of $1.6 billion in outstanding loans.
"Twenty-five percent of that is in open positions," she said. "From July 1 to end-July, this means a transalation loss of 70 billion rupiah before taxes."
She said that assuming that the rupiah is at 2,650 against the dollar at the end of 1997, the company's financing charges would increase by 15 percent in rupiah terms.
The rupiah plunged to a record low on Thursday after the central bank lifted its intervention band and was last trading at 2,755/85 against the dollar.
